title: Serpent of the Cosmos
description: A large purple serpent with a glowing red third eye coils through a cosmic nebula-filled sky, its body looping above a hiker in full color. Below are black and white line art versions of the same hiker in different environments, a detailed snake head in the upper left, and a crystal ball containing a miniature version of the scene.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene featuring a massive purple serpent with a glowing red third eye and yellow eyes coiled through swirling purple and blue nebulae and stars. A fully colored backpacking hiker stands on the serpent's body looking at a crystal ball that contains a miniature version of the scene. In the lower left a black silhouette hiker with backpack and walking stick explores a dark purple flower field. In the lower right a white line art hiker with backpack and stick walks on a purple path. Upper left shows a detailed white line art snake head. Black space background with stars and a small red planet.
